column1: # Short forms of decision titles: id, decision number, short form.
# Written by hand beside the generated titles.tsv. cite-rewrite writes a short form in place of the
# heading, and only for a heading that holds an enhancement id (a test fails for any other row, and
# for a heading that holds an id and has no row). A short form removes the id and keeps the words
# around it, or names the enhancement by its subject; it drops no clause, exception, negation or
# scope limit, and it holds no decision number (no bare D<n>). A long title is written in full. Keep this file sorted by id and number.
